name: APPEAL_GRV_NOTIF_TAT
description: This table holds information about notifications that complete required turnaround time events for appeals and grievances. Each row corresponds to an individual turnaround time requirement and the communication that satisfied that requirement.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the appeal/grievance record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: NOTIF_TAT_TIME_STANDARD_C_NAME
columns.description: The timeliness standard category ID that corresponds to this notification requirement.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_LETTER_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The notification type category ID for this notification requirement.

columns.name: NOTIF_TAT_RECIP_CLASS_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the recipient class that this notification is required to be sent to.

columns.name: NOTIF_TAT_METHOD_C_NAME
columns.description: The category ID for how this notification is required to be sent. (Oral vs Written)

columns.name: NOTIF_TAT_DUE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that this notification requirement is due. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: NOTIF_TAT_OCCUR_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that this notification was submitted. NULL indicates that the notification is still outstanding. Stored in UTC.

columns.name: NOTIF_LETTER
columns.description: The letter GUID (I TAG 5020) that satisfies this notification requirement.

columns.name: NOTIF_CALL_COMM_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the communication that satisfies this notification requirement.

columns.name: NOTIF_TAT_DUE_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that this notification requirement is due. Stored in the time zone determined by column APPEAL_GRV.TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.

columns.name: NOTIF_TAT_OCCUR_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that this notification was submitted. NULL indicates that the notification is still outstanding. Stored in the time zone determined by column APPEAL_GRV.TAT_RPT_TIME_ZONE_C.
